instruction.text: Find the image of autumn on the diagram to learn more.

feedback.end: Autumn comes after summer. The months of September, October and November make up autumn.

instruction.text: Find the grey sky to learn more about the weather in the autumn.

feedback.correct: These months start off warm but gradually get colder, and it begins to get dark earlier. It can also get quite wet and windy during the autumn.

instruction.text: Find the orange leaves on the tree to learn more about plants during the autumn.

feedback.correct: In the autumn, leaves turn orange and fall off the trees. Farmers also harvest the crops they grew during the summer.

instruction.text: Which of these things do you think you would see in autumn? Drag the images to the correct groups.

hint.text: Select an image to hear a description.

feedback.finish: Great work! Animals use the autumn months to prepare for winter. You might notice squirrels burying nuts or hedgehogs going into hibernation. Hibernation is a sleep that lasts for the whole of winter!
